description: This Dart file defines the VideoControlsOverlay widget for a Flutter application, providing overlay controls for video playback such as play/pause, buffering indicator, mute, progress scrubber, and error handling. It interacts with a VideoPlayerProvider to manage video state.

classes.name: _ErrorOverlay

classes.name: _BottomControlsBar
classes.description: A widget displaying bottom controls for the video, including mute toggle, progress slider, and current/duration time display.
